messages:
Samir Patel: Heads-up — BlueRidge Health SIG follow-up. They flagged the KMS/HSM question and are asking for a FIPS-validated HSM for our Private deployment. They want either proof or a formal risk acceptance before contract signature.

Alex Park: Do we have the exact questionnaire text they cited? I asked the AE to paste it but haven't seen it yet. Need to tell the customer a timeline.

Samir Patel: Pasting the snippet they sent: ```Q: Do you support customer data encryption with FIPS 140-2 validated HSMs for key storage and cryptographic operations? If not, provide compensating controls and evidence.```

Maria Chen: Thanks. Quick summary from sec: our current Redwood Private KMS uses cloud-managed HSM backing (AWS/GCP CAS) but we don't run a FIPS 140-2 validated HSM appliance under customer scope for on-prem/private installs by default.

Maria Chen: Possible approaches: 1) Customer-managed CMEK in their cloud account (recommended), 2) HSM appliance option (partner procured) for on-prem — large lead time, or 3) documented compensating controls + formal risk acceptance.

Elaine Gomez: Technical note: We can integrate CMK (customer-managed key) where the key lives in the customer's cloud project/account and we call it via IAM/EKM or cross-account KMS. That satisfies many auditors but does not produce our own FIPS cert. On-prem HSM appliance is feasible but requires network, provisioning, and legal to sign off — ~6-8 weeks and non-trivial costs.

Alex Park: Customer asked for timeline today. Samir, can you tell them an interim answer and when we can provide a signed RA?

Samir Patel: I proposed: "We can accept a risk exception conditioned on the customer using CMEK in their account + continuous audit log export to their SIEM + contractual key access limitations. We'll provide a formal RA doc within 2 business days and a remediation plan if they need on-prem HSM." They pushed back asking if Security can pre-approve that.

Maria Chen: To move forward Security needs: - the exact SIG control text (we have it) - confirmation that customer will supply the CMEK from their account and we will never persist key material in our control plane - evidence of audit log forwarding (Cloud Audit Logs -> customer SIEM) - a signed risk acceptance form and legal acknowledgement. If all present, Sec can provisionally approve the exception for go-live.

Maria Chen: Required mitigations we will insist on (compensating controls):
- CMEK hosted in customer's cloud account with CMK policy denying Redwood root access
- Envelope encryption on our side with ephemeral data keys; no long-term plaintext keys in Redwood infra
- Key usage and rotation policy documented (rotation every 90 days or customer policy)
- Audit logs forwarded to customer's SIEM (immutable storage) and shared for 90 days retention
- Contract addendum for key-handling and deletion procedures

sec-review-bot: Created RA draft https://redwood.internal/ra/RA-2026-091 (please attach evidence). Checklist: CMEK confirmation, audit forwarding screenshot, legal addendum.

Elaine Gomez: I'll scope technical steps for CMEK integration and produce a short runbook. Estimate: 2-3 days engineering work to enable and test in a staging Private deployment. On-prem HSM procurement: 6-8 weeks if they insist.

Alex Park: What's the expected cost delta if they want on-prem HSM vs CMEK? Need numbers for procurement and recurring SOC/attestation maintenance.

Elaine Gomez: Rough ballpark: HSM appliance + setup + support ~ $80k-$150k upfront + $2k-$5k/month for maintenance and attestation facilitation. CMEK: engineering effort included in Private onboarding; no large direct hardware cost.

Samir Patel: Ok I'll tell the customer: offer CMEK + RA with the mitigation checklist. Ask them if they want the HSM path (we'll provide formal quote). Also I'll attach the RA link and ask for their SIEM export confirmation.

Maria Chen: Once customer provides CMEK confirmation and audit screenshots, I'll review and sign the RA. Security will include an expiry on the exception (90 days) pending either HSM delivery or formal longer-term control evidence.

Samir Patel: Great. I'll get the AE to push the CMEK acceptance and the SIEM proof today. Will update. :thumbsup:

sec-review-bot: RA-2026-091 status updated -> PROVISIONAL_APPROVED (conditions: CMEK + audit forwarding + legal addendum). Entry created in security-approvals log.

Alex Park: Thanks team — keep me posted. I'll sync with customer after Samir confirms evidence.

Samir Patel: Closing loop: AE uploaded CMEK confirmation and export screenshot at 2026-03-21T15:22Z. Please sign when ready.

Maria Chen: Reviewed evidence, matches checklist. Legal notified for addendum. Security signs RA once legal confirms.

Samir Patel: Perfect. I'll wait for Legal then mark the deal as green. :party_parrot:
